prompt: An app for a college canteen where students pre-order lunch and pick it up at a set time.

suggestions.title: Delivery Option
suggestions.why: Some students may need their food delivered to their dorm or study area.
suggestions.change: Add a delivery option where students can select a delivery time and location, with a table_delivery_options table storing delivery preferences.

suggestions.title: Payment Processing
suggestions.why: Students need to be able to pay for their meals through the app.
suggestions.change: Integrate payment processing with a secure payment gateway, storing payment details in a table_payments table.

suggestions.title: Notification System
suggestions.why: Students should get reminders about their upcoming orders and delivery times.
suggestions.change: Implement a notification system that sends push notifications or emails based on order status changes.

suggestions.title: Review and Rating
suggestions.why: Students can provide feedback on meals, helping improve food quality and variety.
suggestions.change: Add a reviews and ratings feature with a table_reviews table that stores student feedback and ratings.

suggestions.title: Search Functionality
suggestions.why: Students should be able to search for specific meals or view their order history easily.
suggestions.change: Add search functionality to the student dashboard and order management API endpoints.

suggestions.title: Admin Reporting
suggestions.why: Staff need tools to track order volume, popular meals, and system performance.
suggestions.change: Create admin reporting dashboards and reports that provide insights into order trends and system metrics.

suggestions.title: Multi-Location Support
suggestions.why: The college may have multiple canteens, so the app should support different locations.
suggestions.change: Extend the app to support multiple locations with location-specific ordering and staff management features.

prompt: An app for a college canteen where students pre-order lunch and pick it up at a set time.

suggestions.title: Delivery Scheduling
suggestions.why: Allows students to schedule delivery to their dorm or home address
suggestions.change: Add a delivery scheduling page where students can enter their address and preferred delivery time, with a table_delivery_schedules table to store this information.

suggestions.title: Payment Processing
suggestions.why: Enables students to link payment methods for automatic billing
suggestions.change: Implement payment processing with a Payments API and a Payments Table to store student payment methods and transaction history.

suggestions.title: Notification System
suggestions.why: Sends reminders about upcoming orders and delivery times
suggestions.change: Develop a notification service that sends email/SMS alerts to students about their orders and delivery schedules.

suggestions.title: Admin Reporting Dashboard
suggestions.why: Provides detailed reports on order trends and student preferences for management insights
suggestions.change: Create an Admin Dashboard with reporting features that display order statistics, popular meals, and student preferences, stored in a Reports Table.

suggestions.title: Review & Rating System
suggestions.why: Encourages students to rate their meals and experiences
suggestions.change: Add a Reviews Page where students can rate meals and leave comments, with a Reviews Table to store this feedback.

suggestions.title: Search & Filter Functionality
suggestions.why: Helps students quickly find and modify their orders
suggestions.change: Implement search and filter features on the Student Dashboard to allow students to easily find and modify their pre-orders.

prompt: A hostel complaint tracker where residents report broken fans or taps and the warden assigns a fix.

suggestions.title: Complaint Status Tracking
suggestions.why: Users need to know the status of their complaint.
suggestions.change: Add a complaint status field to the complaints table and update the complaint list page to show status changes.

suggestions.title: Notification System
suggestions.why: Users need to be notified when their complaint is assigned or resolved.
suggestions.change: Add notification functionality that sends email/SMS alerts when a complaint is assigned or closed, and add a notifications page for users to check their alerts.

suggestions.title: Warden Assignment History
suggestions.why: The warden needs to track which complaints they've worked on.
suggestions.change: Add an assignments table linking complaints to warden ids with timestamps, and update the warden dashboard to show their assignment history.

suggestions.title: Complaint Priority System
suggestions.why: The warden needs to prioritize urgent complaints over minor ones.
suggestions.change: Add a priority field to the complaints table and update the complaint list to sort by priority, with a color-coded indicator on the warden dashboard.

suggestions.title: Complaint Photo Upload
suggestions.why: Users can attach photos of the broken fixture for better understanding.
suggestions.change: Add a file upload field to the complaint form and store uploaded images in a cloud storage service, linking them to the complaints table.

prompt: A blood donor finder for a city: donors register their blood group and hospitals search when they need someone.

suggestions.title: Donation History
suggestions.why: Track which donors have already donated to avoid double-dipping.
suggestions.change: Add a Donations Table linking donors to their donation records, with timestamps and quantities.

suggestions.title: Hospitals Register
suggestions.why: Allow hospitals to register and manage their blood needs.
suggestions.change: Add a Hospitals Table with fields for hospital name, location, and contact person, plus a Hospitals API for CRUD operations.

suggestions.title: Notification System
suggestions.why: Send alerts to donors when their blood is urgently needed.
suggestions.change: Implement a Notifications API that sends SMS or email alerts to donors based on their preferences.

suggestions.title: Donor Search Dashboard
suggestions.why: Provide donors with a dashboard showing their recent activity and upcoming appointments.
suggestions.change: Create a Donor Dashboard Page that shows a donor's donation history and upcoming scheduled donations.

suggestions.title: User Authentication
suggestions.why: Protect sensitive donor information and ensure only authorized users can access the system.
suggestions.change: Add User Authentication with login/logout functionality and role-based access control.

prompt: A tuition centre app where teachers post homework and parents see marks for each test.

suggestions.title: Class Scheduling
suggestions.why: Parents need to know when their children have classes
suggestions.change: Add a class schedule page where teachers can add and edit class times, and a parent dashboard that shows their child's schedule.

suggestions.title: Payment Tracking
suggestions.why: Parents need to track payments and balance with the tuition centre
suggestions.change: Add a payments table and API endpoints for tracking payments, balances, and payment history.

suggestions.title: Notification System
suggestions.why: Parents need to be notified about important updates and deadlines
suggestions.change: Implement a notification system that sends email/SMS alerts for important events like homework deadlines or test results.

suggestions.title: Student Profile
suggestions.why: Parents need to see detailed information about their children's performance
suggestions.change: Add a student profile page that shows a comprehensive view of a student's academic performance, including grades, attendance, and test results.

suggestions.title: Admin Dashboard
suggestions.why: The owner needs a dashboard to monitor overall centre performance and manage staff
suggestions.change: Create an admin dashboard that provides an overview of centre operations, including student performance metrics, teacher activity, and financial summaries.

suggestions.title: Review System
suggestions.why: Parents need to provide feedback on teachers and services
suggestions.change: Add a review system where parents can rate teachers and leave comments about their experience.

suggestions.title: Search Functionality
suggestions.why: Parents need to easily find information about their children's classes and performance
suggestions.change: Implement a search function that allows parents to find specific classes, homework assignments, and test results by date, subject, or student name.

prompt: A temple donation register that records offerings and prints a receipt for each donor.

suggestions.title: Donation Receipt Email
suggestions.why: Send donors an email receipt for their donation record
suggestions.change: Add an email receipt feature that sends a confirmation email with donor details and amount after a donation is made.

suggestions.title: Monthly Donation Scheduling
suggestions.why: Allow donors to set up recurring monthly donations
suggestions.change: Add a recurring donations page where donors can set up monthly donations, stored in a recurring_donations table with fields for donor id, amount, frequency, and next_scheduled_date.

suggestions.title: Donation Search and Filter
suggestions.why: Enable staff to search and filter donations by date range, amount, or donor name
suggestions.change: Add a staff dashboard with search and filter capabilities for donations, with a donations_search table for storing search parameters and results.

suggestions.title: Donation Report Generation
suggestions.why: Generate monthly or yearly donation reports for financial tracking
suggestions.change: Add a report generation feature that creates downloadable CSV or PDF reports of donations, with a reports table for storing report metadata and generated files.

suggestions.title: Donation Acknowledgment Letters
suggestions.why: Send formal acknowledgment letters to major donors
suggestions.change: Add a letter generation feature that creates personalized acknowledgment letters for high-value donors, with a letters table for storing letter content and send status.

prompt: A kirana shop credit book: the owner records what each regular customer owes and when they pay.

suggestions.title: Regular Billing
suggestions.why: Regular billing keeps the owner informed about ongoing balances and encourages timely payments from customers.
suggestions.change: Add a billing page where the owner can generate monthly bills for customers with their current balances, and a table_bills table to store billing records.

suggestions.title: Customer Search
suggestions.why: A search function allows the owner to quickly find customers by name or ID.
suggestions.change: Add a search bar to the customer list page that filters customers by name or ID.

suggestions.title: Payment Reminders
suggestions.why: Reminders help the owner keep track of overdue payments and maintain good customer relationships.
suggestions.change: Add a payment reminders page that shows customers with unpaid balances, and a table_reminders table to store reminder records.

suggestions.title: Customer Groups
suggestions.why: Grouping customers can help the owner manage large numbers of customers more efficiently.
suggestions.change: Add a customer groups page where the owner can create and manage groups of customers, and a customers_groups table to store group assignments.

prompt: An app to split rent and electricity bills among flatmates.

suggestions.title: Budget Tracker
suggestions.why: Helps track monthly spending limits per flatmate
suggestions.change: Add a budgets table with flatmate_id, month, and budget_amount fields, and a budget tracker page that shows remaining budget per month.

suggestions.title: Notification System
suggestions.why: Sends reminders when bills are due or payments are overdue
suggestions.change: Implement email and in-app notification features triggered by bill due dates or payment deadlines.

suggestions.title: Payment Processing
suggestions.why: Handles secure payment processing for flatmates
suggestions.change: Integrate with a payment gateway API to process payments securely and update balances accordingly.

suggestions.title: Admin Dashboard
suggestions.why: Provides an overview for flatmates to manage their finances
suggestions.change: Create an admin dashboard page that shows overall financial health, recent transactions, and allows managing flatmate accounts.

suggestions.title: Review System
suggestions.why: Encourages flatmates to rate and review each other
suggestions.change: Add a reviews table with flatmate_id, reviewer_id, rating, and comment fields, and a reviews page where flatmates can rate and comment on each other.

suggestions.title: Search Functionality
suggestions.why: Allows searching through bills and payments
suggestions.change: Implement full-text search capabilities on the dashboard and payment log pages to quickly find specific bills or payments.

prompt: A crop price board where farmers see today's mandi prices for their district.

suggestions.title: Price History
suggestions.why: Farmers need past prices to make informed decisions about selling crops.
suggestions.change: Add a Price History page that shows a chart of price trends over the last 30 days, stored in a mandi_prices_history table.

suggestions.title: Price Alerts
suggestions.why: Farmers should be notified when prices rise above their threshold.
suggestions.change: Add a Price Alerts feature where farmers set a minimum price threshold, and receive email/SMS alerts when prices exceed it, using a price_alerts table.

suggestions.title: Commodity Selection
suggestions.why: Farmers may have multiple crops and need to switch between them.
suggestions.change: Add a Commodity Selection page where farmers can choose which crop's prices to view, stored in a user_commodities table.

suggestions.title: Price Comparison
suggestions.why: Farmers need to compare prices from different mandis to find the best deal.
suggestions.change: Add a Price Comparison page that shows side-by-side comparisons of prices from multiple mandis, stored in a mandi_price_comparisons table.

prompt: A cricket club scorebook that keeps match scores and player averages for a season.

suggestions.title: Live Score Updates
suggestions.why: Umpires and coaches need real-time score updates during matches
suggestions.change: Add a live_score_updates table with match_id, over, balls, runs, wickets, and timestamps, and a websocket API for live updates.

suggestions.title: Team Performance Reports
suggestions.why: Coaches need detailed reports on team performance across matches
suggestions.change: Add a team_performance_reports table with match_id, team, runs_scored, runs_conceded, wickets_taken, and timestamps, and a reports API endpoint.

suggestions.title: Player Match Details
suggestions.why: Parents and players want to see individual match performances
suggestions.change: Add a player_match_details table with player_id, match_id, innings, runs_scored, wickets_taken, and timestamps, and a match_details API endpoint.

suggestions.title: Season Summary Dashboard
suggestions.why: Club members need quick access to season summary statistics
suggestions.change: Add a season_summary_dashboard page with charts and summaries of key metrics like total runs, wickets, and average scores, and a dashboard API endpoint.

suggestions.title: Player Injury Tracking
suggestions.why: Medical staff need to track player injuries and recovery progress
suggestions.change: Add a player_injury_tracking table with player_id, injury_details, treatment_plan, recovery_progress, and timestamps, and a medical_api endpoint.

suggestions.title: Match Scheduling
suggestions.why: Admins need to schedule matches in advance
suggestions.change: Add a match_scheduling page with date, time, venue, and team selection forms, and a matches table with scheduled_date and scheduled_time fields.

suggestions.title: Player Availability Calendar
suggestions.why: Managers need to track player availability for scheduling
suggestions.change: Add a player_availability_calendar page with calendar view showing player availability, and a player_availability table with player_id, date, availability_status, and timestamps.

prompt: A society parking app where residents register vehicles and guards check them at the gate.

suggestions.title: Vehicle Search
suggestions.why: Residents need to quickly find their vehicle by make, model, or colour.
suggestions.change: Add a search function to the resident dashboard that filters vehicles by make, model, or colour.

suggestions.title: Guard Login
suggestions.why: Only authorized guards need access to the gate check panel.
suggestions.change: Implement a guard login system with role-based access control for the gate guard check panel.

suggestions.title: Parking Slot Management
suggestions.why: The app should track which parking slots are occupied.
suggestions.change: Add a parking_slots table with slot number, current_vehicle_id, and last_updated timestamp, and update the gate check logic to handle slot availability.

suggestions.title: Notification System
suggestions.why: Residents should be notified when their vehicle is checked at the gate.
suggestions.change: Implement a notification service that sends email/SMS alerts to residents when their vehicle is checked at the gate.

prompt: A library seat booking system for a reading room with fixed time slots.

suggestions.title: Seat Availability Widget
suggestions.why: Users need real-time visibility into available seats to avoid double-booking
suggestions.change: Add a widget to the seat booking page that shows available seats in color-coding, updated in real-time to prevent overbooking

suggestions.title: Notification System
suggestions.why: Users need to be notified when their booking is confirmed or when a seat is available for immediate use
suggestions.change: Implement email/SMS notifications for booking confirmations, cancellations, and seat availability alerts

suggestions.title: Payment Integration
suggestions.why: The system should support payment processing for premium seating or extended booking periods
suggestions.change: Add payment processing functionality with integration to payment gateways like Stripe or PayPal, storing payment details securely in the database

suggestions.title: Admin Reporting Dashboard
suggestions.why: Staff need comprehensive reporting tools to track usage patterns and identify seating trends
suggestions.change: Develop a reporting dashboard for admins to view booking statistics, seat usage trends, and generate reports on popular times and locations

suggestions.title: Review System
suggestions.why: Users should be able to rate their experience and provide feedback on specific seating areas
suggestions.change: Add a review system where users can rate their experience and leave comments about specific seats or time slots, stored in a reviews table

prompt: A placement cell portal where companies post drives and students apply.

suggestions.title: Job Role Management
suggestions.why: Allow companies to specify job roles for each drive to help students filter applications
suggestions.change: Add a job_roles table linking to drives and a form to add roles per drive on the company dashboard.

suggestions.title: Application Status Tracking
suggestions.why: Enable companies to track application status and communicate with students
suggestions.change: Add application_status and communication fields to the applications table and update the student dashboard to show status.

suggestions.title: Student Profile Management
suggestions.why: Allow students to maintain their profiles including resume upload and preferences
suggestions.change: Add a students table with fields for student id, name, email, resume file, and preferences, and a student profile form on the student dashboard.

suggestions.title: Notification System
suggestions.why: Send automated notifications to students about their application status and company updates
suggestions.change: Implement email and SMS notification services tied to application status changes and company communications.

suggestions.title: Company Authentication
suggestions.why: Add multi-factor authentication for company accounts to enhance security
suggestions.change: Implement MFA for company login and update the company dashboard to require MFA.

suggestions.title: Search and Filter
suggestions.why: Provide advanced search and filtering capabilities for both companies and students
suggestions.change: Add search functionality to the company dashboard and student dashboard with filters for date, job roles, and status.

prompt: A bus pass renewal app for a city transport office.

suggestions.title: Multi-Mode Renewal
suggestions.why: Allows passengers to renew multiple passes in one session
suggestions.change: Add a renewal form that can handle multiple pass types and collect all renewal details in one session.

suggestions.title: Pass Delivery
suggestions.why: Simplifies pass distribution and tracking
suggestions.change: Add a pass delivery page where staff can mark passes as shipped and track delivery status, with a table_pass_deliveries table.

suggestions.title: Payment History
suggestions.why: Helps passengers track their payment transactions
suggestions.change: Add a payment history page that shows transaction details, with a table_payment_history table.

suggestions.title: Admin Reporting
suggestions.why: Provides staff with insights into renewal trends and issues
suggestions.change: Add a reporting dashboard that shows renewal statistics, payment trends, and problem areas, with a table_reports table.

suggestions.title: Customer Reviews
suggestions.why: Improves service quality through feedback
suggestions.change: Add a review system where passengers can rate their renewal experience and leave comments, with a table_reviews table.

suggestions.title: Search Functionality
suggestions.why: Enhances user experience by allowing quick access to specific passes
suggestions.change: Add a search bar to the pass list page that allows passengers to find their passes by name, email, or pass type.

prompt: A plant nursery inventory with plants, pots and seasonal stock.

suggestions.title: Order Management
suggestions.why: Allow customers to place orders for plants, pots, and seasonal items with delivery options
suggestions.change: Add an Orders page with form fields for customer name, address, phone, items selected, quantity, delivery date, and payment status. Store order details in an orders table with foreign key relationships to inventory tables.

suggestions.title: Payment Processing
suggestions.why: Process payments securely for online orders and in-store purchases
suggestions.change: Integrate with a payment processor API to handle credit card transactions, store payment information securely, and update order status accordingly.

suggestions.title: Delivery Tracking
suggestions.why: Track shipping status and provide customers with delivery updates
suggestions.change: Create a Delivery Tracking page to log shipping information, tracking numbers, and delivery statuses. Add columns to orders table for shipping date, carrier, and tracking number.

suggestions.title: Customer Accounts
suggestions.why: Allow customers to create accounts, save preferences, and view order history
suggestions.change: Implement a Customers table with fields for customer ID, name, email, password hash, phone, address, and account creation date. Add login functionality and customer profile management.

suggestions.title: Inventory Reports
suggestions.why: Generate reports on stock levels, sales trends, and inventory turnover
suggestions.change: Develop Reporting pages with dashboards showing inventory levels, sales data, and trends over time. Create reports table to store generated report data and metadata.

suggestions.title: Admin Dashboard
suggestions.why: Provide administrators with a comprehensive view of all inventory and sales data
suggestions.change: Create an Admin Dashboard page with widgets showing key metrics, recent activity, and quick access to inventory management tools. Enhance staff page to include admin-specific features.

suggestions.title: Product Reviews
suggestions.why: Collect customer feedback and improve product offerings through reviews
suggestions.change: Add a Reviews page where customers can rate and comment on plants, pots, and seasonal items. Store review data in a reviews table with foreign key relationships to inventory tables.

suggestions.title: Search Enhancements
suggestions.why: Improve search functionality with fuzzy matching and autocomplete features
suggestions.change: Enhance search functionality by implementing fuzzy matching algorithms and autocomplete suggestions for plant names, pot types, and seasonal items. Update search functionality in inventory dashboard and individual management pages.

prompt: An app for a dance academy to manage batches, fees and attendance.

suggestions.title: Payment Processing
suggestions.why: Allow parents to easily make payments online for their children's classes
suggestions.change: Add a payment processing page with forms for parents to enter payment details, and update the Fees table with transaction information.

suggestions.title: Notification System
suggestions.why: Keep parents informed about class changes, attendance records, and upcoming events
suggestions.change: Implement email and SMS notification features that can be triggered from the backend based on specific events or conditions.

suggestions.title: Class Scheduling
suggestions.why: Enable staff to schedule classes and manage time slots for different batches
suggestions.change: Add a scheduling page where instructors can create and manage class schedules, which will be stored in a separate Schedules table linked to Batches.

suggestions.title: Parent-Teacher Communication
suggestions.why: Provide a platform for parents to send messages to instructors and vice versa
suggestions.change: Develop a messaging system that allows parents to send text messages to instructors, with messages stored in a Messages table.

suggestions.title: Report Generation
suggestions.why: Generate reports for financial tracking, attendance statistics, and student performance
suggestions.change: Create reporting pages that generate PDF or CSV files containing detailed financial and attendance data, and store report generation logs in a Reports table.

suggestions.title: Student Progress Tracking
suggestions.why: Track students' progress through different skill levels and performance metrics
suggestions.change: Add a progress tracking page where instructors can log student achievements, and store progress data in a Progress table linked to Students.

prompt: A cycle rental service at a railway station.

suggestions.title: Cycle Availability Widget

suggestions.change: Add a widget to the Rental Dashboard that shows available cycles by location and time slot, updated in real-time from the Cycles Table

suggestions.title: Payment Processing
suggestions.why: Owners need secure payment processing for rental transactions

suggestions.title: Notification System

suggestions.change: Develop a notification system that sends email/SMS alerts based on user preferences and system events, using a Notifications Table to track sent messages

suggestions.title: Admin Dashboard
suggestions.why: Owners need an administrative dashboard to manage all aspects of the rental service
suggestions.change: Create an Admin Dashboard page that provides overview statistics, allows managing all services (cycles, users, rentals), and handles system settings

suggestions.title: Customer Reviews
suggestions.why: Owners need customer feedback to improve service quality
suggestions.change: Add a Reviews Table that allows customers to rate and review their rental experience, with features to manage reviews and display them on the Rental Dashboard

prompt: A recipe sharing app where home cooks post regional dishes and others rate them.

suggestions.title: Search Function
suggestions.why: Users should be able to search recipes by keywords or ingredients
suggestions.change: Add a search bar to the recipe list page that queries the recipes table by title, ingredients, or steps.

suggestions.title: Category Management
suggestions.why: Users need to organize recipes into categories like 'Main Dishes', 'Desserts', etc.
suggestions.change: Add category creation and assignment forms, and update the recipe form to include category selection. Add a categories table and update the recipes table to link recipes to categories.

suggestions.title: User Profile
suggestions.why: Users should be able to see their own recipes and ratings
suggestions.change: Add a user profile page that lists a user's recipes and their ratings. Update the authentication system to handle user profiles.

suggestions.title: Recipe Comments
suggestions.why: Users should be able to discuss recipes in detail
suggestions.change: Add a comments section to recipe detail pages where users can post text comments. Create a comments table that links comments to recipes and users.

suggestions.title: Recipe Images
suggestions.why: Recipes should have visual representation
suggestions.change: Add image upload functionality to the recipe form and detail page. Update the recipes table to store image URLs.

suggestions.title: Patient Registration
suggestions.why: Allows new patients to register and be assigned a token.
suggestions.change: Add a registration page where patients enter their details and receive a token, with a queue table entry tracking their position.

suggestions.title: Staff Dashboard
suggestions.why: Enables staff to view queue status and manage patients.
suggestions.change: Create a staff dashboard page showing the current queue and allowing staff to mark patients as seen or handle emergencies.

suggestions.title: Notification System
suggestions.why: Sends alerts to patients when it's their turn or when their position changes.
suggestions.change: Implement a notification service that sends messages to patients via SMS or app notifications based on their queue position.

suggestions.title: Queue History
suggestions.why: Lets patients and staff view past queue positions for reference.
suggestions.change: Add a queue history page that shows the patient's past positions and timestamps, stored in a queue_history table.

suggestions.title: Admin Panel
suggestions.why: Provides administrators with system oversight and management capabilities.
suggestions.change: Develop an admin panel with pages for viewing all tokens, managing patients, and adjusting queue settings, secured with role-based access control.

prompt: A laptop repair shop job card system.

suggestions.why: Allows customers to make payments for repairs through the system
suggestions.change: Add a payment processing page where customers can enter payment details and a payments table to track transactions.

suggestions.title: Notification System

suggestions.title: Review Management

suggestions.change: Add a scheduling page where staff can view their availability and a schedule table to track appointments and time blocks.

prompt: A courier pickup request app for a small town.

suggestions.title: Notification System

suggestions.title: Volunteer Reports

suggestions.change: Implement reporting features on the admin dashboard that allow viewing and exporting volunteer statistics and shift attendance reports.

prompt: A carpentry workshop project and material tracker.

suggestions.title: Project Scheduling

suggestions.change: Add scheduling features to the Project Form with fields for estimated start date, end date, and duration. Implement calendar views and Gantt chart visualization for project timelines.

suggestions.title: Material Usage Tracking
suggestions.why: Record how much material is used for each task to track consumption and improve cost tracking.
suggestions.change: Add a Material Usage Log page where users can log how much material is used for specific tasks. Store this information in a material_usage table with fields for task_id, material_id, quantity_used, and date.

suggestions.title: Customer Management
suggestions.why: Track customer information and project relationships for better service and billing.

suggestions.title: Payment Tracking
suggestions.why: Manage payment records and track financial transactions related to projects and materials.
suggestions.change: Add a Payments page with fields for payment amount, payment date, payment method, and reference number. Link payments to projects and materials through foreign key relationships.

suggestions.title: Notification System
suggestions.why: Send alerts and reminders for upcoming tasks, project deadlines, and low stock conditions.

suggestions.title: Notification System

suggestions.title: Admin Dashboard

suggestions.title: Payment Processing
